items.title: Manuel Joseph "Moose" Zanco Interview, 1959-11-25
items.q: He sounds pretty much like a, a recording I have of Emmett Hardy.

ctx.x: He sounds pretty much like a, a recording I have of Emmett Hardy. Their stuff sounds pretty much the same, you know, and I like that. I like that, that style.
I don't think you have a record of Emmett Hardy. Was it Emmett Hardy? I don't think he made any records I've ever issued.
